evals.name: errored-mutant-cluster-is-test-autoloading
evals.prompt: Infection reports 61 errors on our TYPO3 site project, every one of them 'Class "Vendor\Ext\Tests\Unit\Validation\AbstractValidatorTest" not found', while the normal phpunit run is green. The covered-code MSI is 78%. Can I trust that number, and what should I fix?

assertions.description: Says errored mutants count as killed, so the 78% is inflated
Concludes that the reported MSI is inflated and cannot be trusted until the errors are fixed
Names the missing autoload-dev mapping for the test namespace as the cause
Puts the mapping in the root composer.json, not the extension's
